data_description.api_key: Personal API Token from the OpenCARWINGS portal (Account Settings -> API Token).
data_description.command_pin: Required only for security-sensitive commands (Doors Lock/Unlock and Remote Start/Stop).
data_description.abrp_user_token: Automatically forward live vehicle telemetry to A Better Routeplanner (ABRP -> Car Settings -> Live Data -> Generic). Leave blank to disable.
data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant polls the OpenCARWINGS cloud.
data_description.api_base_url: Base URL of your OpenCARWINGS server instance.
